induction.definition: second-copy i to first-copy i+1 attention minus non-target first-copy mean
induction.global_definition: mean of five highest per-head means at this checkpoint
induction.probe: repeated contiguous windows from frozen task prompts

qk_attention.attention_definition: query attention to current write minus summed attention to stale writes
qk_attention.qk_definition: answer-position rotated query dot write-position rotated key / sqrt(head_dim)
